title: Person: Nasty Roche
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Nasty Roche

anchor.prefix:
ectory. Nasty Roche had big hands. He called the Friday pudding dog-in-the-blanket. And one day he had asked:

 —What is your name?

 Stephen had answered: Stephen Dedalus.

 Then
anchor.suffix:
had said:

 —What kind of a name is that?

 And when Stephen had not been able to answer Nasty Roche had asked:

 —What is your father?

 Stephen had answered:

 —A gentleman.
